name: core.select
title: Switch the active outbound among already-loaded servers
summary: Imperative fast path, deliberately distinct from config.apply: it changes which already-configured outbound is active for subsequent connections without writing a config and without restarting Core. Confusing the two is how a UI quick switch ends up killing every live connection.

configHashUnchanged.description: Asserts the promise: select never changes the applied config, so it never triggers a restart. If an implementation cannot guarantee this it must expose config.apply instead.

liveConnectionsAffected.description: Reported honestly. Existing connections keep their outbound; only new connections follow the switch.

invariants: serverId must already be present in the applied config; selecting an unloaded server is InvalidProfile, never an implicit config.apply.
A repeated select of the same server is a no-op with changed=false and must not bump any counter that the UI reads as activity.
